finding.title: _lm_solve's full-solve band projection is unpinned: `>= 3` -> `> 3` lets the slab fit run away
finding.claim: With `x.size >= 3` -> `> 3`, _lm_solve no longer projects log UA and log C_r in identify_slab's three-parameter solve: a direct call returns log UA 6.908 instead of the band edge 4.605, and identify_slab on a noisy night with a (1e-3, 1e-3) prior asks the rollout for an out-of-band plant after 5 rollouts (baseline: 0 of 427) and then did not finish in 200 s where the baseline takes 0.4 s; the full gate stays green.
finding.severity_reason: a runaway fit is CPU on the solve worker (bounded only by max_iter and the rollout's substep count); needs a far-off prior plus noise
finding.metric_definition: rollouts identify_slab requests with UA or C_r outside the SLAB_LOG band, counted to the first
